message:
Now I need to understand the input format. The fuzzer passes the raw data as IEs to `p2p_scan_res_handler`. The IEs need to contain a P2P IE (vendor specific IE with OUI 0x50 0x6f 0x9a and type 0x09) that includes a P2P Group Info attribute.

Let me look at how P2P IEs are parsed and what the P2P Group Info attribute looks like. Let me check `p2p_parse_ies` and the P2P IE structure:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "p2p_parse_ies\|p2p_parse_p2p_ie" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hostap/src/p2p/p2p_parse.c | head -10</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
